agent.reasons: Beneficial ownership is not complete. 30% of the shares belong to no one on record, and Granite Holdings LLC holds 44% with unknown owners and no showing that it is an excluded entity. Either gap could hide an individual owning 25% or more, so 3.3 requires requesting documents. The other checks pass: the control person, Mateo Weiss, is identified and verified; the registry filing is about 9 months old; screening, industry and geography are clear. Even so, approval is not possible.
still_needed: Who holds the 30% of shares not on record
Owners of Granite Holdings LLC, or proof that it is an excluded entity under 31 CFR 1010.230(e)(2)
Identity verification and screening (sanctions, PEP, adverse media, location) of any further individual owning 25% or more
Search records for the adverse media checks (terms, date, sources), as 4.4 requires
